contexts.text: They who cry to and implore Him for themselves alone, and thus against others, as the evil are wont to do, these, too, the Lord hears, but does not render them aid, and (therefore) it is said that he does not hear.
For they implore immediate mercy, DP 221.
Every man... can shun evils as of himself by the Lord's power, if he implores it. DLife 104:end. DP 278.
Unless he also acknowledges God, and implores His aid...
The Lord provides the rest, if He is implored.
